title: auto-man cross-run architecture delta (~/.claude/auto-man/arch-delta.jsonl)
description: One line per completed run — a mechanically-derived summary of what SHAPE of the system changed, deliberately NOT the diff itself. Exists so a human owner can review O(subsystems) per batch (see SKILL.md Step 8) instead of O(diffs) per run. Distinct from ledger.jsonl: the ledger is quantitative run telemetry (cost/turns/outcome) sized for MAX_TURNS derivation; this file is qualitative 'what changed shape', sized for a human batch review. Every field here except humanReviewRequested is neutral description — nothing in this file judges whether a change was risky; that judgment is the human's, made at Step 0 and recorded in humanReviewRequested. Append-only: never rewrite a prior line except to set reviewedAt, and only Step 8 may do that, only after explicit human acknowledgment.

project.description: Project name or path, for grouping in batch review

phase.description: Phase name within a multi-phase plan this row belongs to (see SKILL.md's 'Multi-phase plans' section); null for an ordinary single-phase run. Lets Step 8 group a plan's phases together instead of reading them as unrelated runs of the same project.

runRef.description: This run's LOOP_RUN_ID or the delivered commit hash — lets a batch review pull the full diff for one flagged row without needing anything else

diffLoc.description: Total lines added+removed across the final diff

humanReviewRequested.description: The user's OWN answer, given at Step 0 before implementation started, to 'does this need your full review once it's done?'. This is the single routing signal for Step 6's reminder and Step 8's bucketing — there is deliberately no heuristic risk classification anywhere in this file. Never infer this value from the diff — it comes from the user, or the run has no business claiming an answer.

reviewedAt.description: Null means still pending a human's eyes. Set ONLY by Step 8, ONLY on that row after the human has actually acknowledged it (individually, or as part of an explicitly-accepted 'delivered clean' rollup) — Step 6 must always write null here. A row silently marked reviewed without a human having looked defeats the entire point of this file.

notes.description: Free-text one-liner, e.g. anything about the change's shape worth a sentence that the numbers alone don't convey
